fem_nodes_load — DRIVE tacslip op

• Data kinds: text × text → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.fem_nodes_load(dirpath: 'str', name: 'str') -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import tacslip; tacslip.fem_nodes_load(dirpath: 'str', name: 'str') -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("fem_nodes_load"))

Usage

Reads the 3 finite-element surface-node text files (bundled with the Robo-Touch/Taxim repository, MIT license): <dirpath>/<name>_{x,y,z}.txt, tab-separated with a 1-line header Node Number / X Location (m) / Y Location (m) / Z Location (m) / Directional Deformation (m), units m. The 3 files share the same node set; only the last column, the displacement in that direction, differs. Returns id, X, Y, Z, dx, dy, dz (each (N,)), n, name. Raises FileNotFoundError: a file is missing. ValueError: wrong header, not 5 columns, or the node coordinates of the 3 files do not match (fail-closed).
